title: Full fps game using AI models
author: yanke88
selftext:
So I’m working on a fps war game that I just try to build from my memory as kid , I was playing a game called outpost .. and I’m trying to build it again so my and my brothers can play it again.

Today I added the tag names and rank icons 

OUTPOST — 16 RANKS

Private  
Private Second Class  
Private First Class  
Sergeant  
Sergeant Major  
Command Sergeant Major  
Second Lieutenant  
First Lieutenant  
Captain  
Major  
Lieutenant Colonel  
Colonel  
Brigadier General  
Major General  
Lieutenant General  
General of the Army

You can wear rare items only by ranks.

1,000 points a rank. Rank 1 earns 1 point a kill. By rank 6 it’s 0.30.

41,000 kills to the top.

Nobody’s getting there by accident.

I used the following models for the following jobs

Opus for script   
Fable for build / code

Nano banana - create the 2d image of everything.  
Guns , characters, tools, arena base etc.

Hunyuan 3D pro - turning every part to 3d.

I rigged the characters in T pose in an animated rigged.

The results yet are so good. I like it so much.   
And hope soon we can play all together

comments.author: davesoft
comments.body: Why so zoomed out? And, additionally, aim at the floor, or the ceiling, just to show us you can ;)

replies.author: yanke88
replies.body: Give me every feedback into my face it’s important for me. And I would like to take them

replies.author: davesoft
replies.body: But you have no face. You are zoomed out way too much, and I suspect you cannot look at the ground or ceiling with the current control method.

replies.author: davesoft
replies.body: Interesting how the crosshair is aiming at the floor behind the character eh?
